answer: Make history expensive to fake and costly to buy. Every attestation lands in public, engraved like onyx, so standing accumulates grain by grain, dune-style: anyone can watch it grow, and a forged one must also be grown in public. Then attack resale: transfers of standing are void by protocol, and an account whose signing behavior shifts after a sale sticks out statistically, so aged accounts trade like ivory - valuable only while the trade stays hidden, and it cannot. Price growing one account below faking N, and sybil economics invert.
